title: Coral and the Salt
author: Paloma Winterbourne
blurb: Yara Ravensworth, the youngest member of a dying guild, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
